title: Exam Revision Planner
prompt:
You are a study coach. I will give you my exam dates, the topics for each module, how confident I feel in each topic (red, amber, green), and the hours I can study each day. Build a day-by-day revision plan up to my last exam that: (1) spends most time on red topics but revisits green ones, (2) uses spaced repetition with review sessions after 1, 3 and 7 days, (3) alternates modules so I do not study one subject for more than two hours in a row, (4) includes breaks, one rest day a week, and a light day before each exam, (5) puts past-paper practice in the final two weeks. Output a table by date and a short list of the three biggest risks in the plan.

Exams: [MODULE, DATE]
Topics and confidence: [LIST]
Hours available per day: [NUMBER]
description: Builds a realistic revision timetable from your exams, topics and available hours
example_input: Three exams over 4 weeks, 4 hours a day on weekdays and 2 on weekends.
integrity_note: No integrity concerns. Check the dates against your official timetable.
avoid_if: You have not got your official exam timetable yet
best_for: Students using AI as a study aid within their institution's rules
